role_group_set.note: The omnibus is fitted over exactly these groups. assert_role_coverage() guarantees they are a subset of contract_roles and that every capsule index is in one of them.

levene.note: Brown-Forsythe variant (median-centred). Welch is used for the pairwise comparisons regardless of this result.

welch_anova.why: Sensitivity check for the equal-variance F above, which assumes homoscedasticity; the Levene test rejects it for this model at alpha=0.05. Does not replace it; both are reported.

effect_size.method: eta^2 = F*df_b / (F*df_b + df_w) on the equal-variance decomposition; CI from statsmodels confint_effectsize_oneway (noncentral F).

_multiplicity.note: Post-hoc family following the omnibus ANOVA on the same capsules. Note these are capsules from a SINGLE trained model; the cross-model replication is in the per_model block of the native roll-up, not here.
